entities.summary: Megan J. Smith is an American engineer and technologist. She was the third Chief Technology Officer of the United States and Assistant to the President, serving under President Barack Obama. She was previously a vice president at Google, leading new business development and early-stage partnerships across Google's global engineering and product teams at Google for nine years, was general manager of Google.org, a vice president briefly at Google[x] where she co-created Solve for X and WomenTechmakers, is the former CEO of Planet Out and worked as an engineer on early smartphones at General Magic.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As the third Chief Technology Officer of the United States and Assistant to the President under Barack Obama, Megan Smith played a crucial role in shaping the country's technology policy. Her work on initiatives such as the 'My Brother's Keeper' program and her efforts to promote STEM education for girls have had lasting impacts on American society.
